sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 2 (#1 instruction_is_a_natural_product_request) and Internal Quality Checks row 2 (same text, no extra annotation in columns E-Z)
evidence: Read cold, task/instruction.md is five prose paragraphs in a firm's voice: line 1 states the business problem ('our clients keep emailing documents to whoever answered last. We want a secure chat where each client talks to us inside their legal matter...'), line 3 prioritises two concerns as a person would ('Two things matter more than anything else. First, ethical walls... Second, retention...'), line 5 points to seed data and notes and the required /app/server.js + /app/app.db deliverable (template runtime contract, which check 4 requires), line 7 states the signed-out rule, line 9 asks them to try it in a browser. Grep finds no numbered list, bullet list, table, shall-statements, framework choice or endpoint list in instruction.md; the only 'must' wording is natural prose on line 3. The quality-checks.md:11 defect pattern (numbered acceptance lists, shall/must spec table, feature matrix, build recipe with framework/file layout/endpoint list) is absent. The template placeholder 'CHANGE_ME' has been replaced. The supporting notes are dense but remain motivated first-person prose ('Our clients ask several things at once, so answers have to stay with their question'; 'Our internet in court is patchy'); their one table is the seeded account list (expected demo credentials per SKILL known false positives) and integration.md's Node 22/port/SQLite/GET /api/health lines are the operational runtime contract framed as 'How we run it', not a build recipe. Adversarial angle: this row grades prose, not app behaviour, so no broken app can pass or conforming app fail because of it; the realistic failure mode (an LLM-style spec sheet) is not present. Residual observation only (not a defect): the notes carry many precise rules (e.g. wildcard characters, ten-second propagation), which belongs to fairness/coverage rows rather than this naturalness row.
